text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's preparations for the<n>Twinkle Series
have begun.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She gets excited about winning all<n>sorts of titles in
order to spoil me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I vow to become stronger so I can<n>help her achieve
her goals.
